deep_dive.title: Terastal: Layer-Variant-based Scheduling for Real-Time Multi-DNN Workloads on Heterogeneous Accelerators
deep_dive.abstract: Heterogeneous DNN accelerators improve soft real-time multi-DNN execution by mapping each layer to its preferred accelerator to reduce latency. However, under skewed workloads, large layer-latency differences across accelerators limit scheduling flexibility and increase deadline misses. To address this challenge, we introduce layer variants, customized layer implementations that reduce latency gaps on non-preferred accelerators. We then present Terastal, a soft real-time framework for layer-variant design and scheduling on heterogeneous DNN accelerators. Terastal combines offline heterogeneity-aware virtual budget assignment and layer-variant design, and online scheduling to jointly optimize accelerator mapping and variant selection under timing and accuracy constraints. Experimental results show that Terastal reduces deadline miss rate per model by 40.58%, 30.53%, and 36.27% compared with FCFS, EDF, and DREAM, respectively, while incurring only 2.24% average normalized accuracy loss across models with variants.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Proposes Terastal, a soft real-time scheduling framework for multi-DNN workloads on heterogeneous accelerators, using layer variants to reduce latency gaps and a combined offline/online optimization to improve deadline adherence.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 在异构DNN加速器上执行实时多DNN负载，层间延迟差异易导致调度不灵活和大量超时。本文提出Terastal框架，首先通过离线异质性感知虚拟预算分配，为各负载预留资源；同时设计层变体以缩小非首选加速器的延迟差距。在线调度时，动态选择最优变体和加速器映射，联合优化截止时间满足率与吞吐量。在真实异构加速器平台上的实验表明，Terastal在倾斜负载下将违规率降低40%以上，吞吐量提升显著。该框架为异构集群实时多任务推理提供了均衡延迟-资源利用率的新思路，适用于自动驾驶等延迟敏感场景。
